name: Mysterious Lotus Casebook
description: The two-city RV from the hit drama "Lotus House" is driven by four horses and has an exquisite structure. It is a world-class version of the "Lotus Bochini". Pinku cooperates with the official iQiyi to create an all-metal double-decker RV model of the Lotus Building, recreating the past in the world and interpreting the chivalrous Oriental spirit.
